text: Go.Compare, the WRU's back-of-shirt sponsor, is a brand of Future plc, which completed its acquisition of GoCo Group (the GoCompare owner) in February 2021.
short: Go.Compare is a Future plc brand

source.name: Future plc: Our Brands
source.quote: Go.Compare is the particularly picky comparison site. Helping you compare the cost and features of insurance policies, financial products, energy tariffs and more.
source.note: Undated page; date is the day it was opened. Go.Compare appears in Future plc's 'Our Brands' portfolio list.

additionalSources.name: Future plc: Future plc acquires GoCo Group plc
additionalSources.quote: announces completion of the acquisition of GoCo Group plc (“GoCo”), a data-enabled and tech-led business focused on innovation
additionalSources.note: Completion announcement; the same release names 'Lee Griffin (CEO of GoCompare)' among the GoCo team welcomed to Future.
